The main takeaway from our work is that
methylation of a CpG island in the Surf-1/Su2 promoter has differential effects on transcription factor binding.

CpG methilation of the Surf-2 promoter can have two distinct effects: (1) it can prevent ETS factor from binding to the Su2 element; and (2) it can repress transcription by preventing the binding of the transcription factor YY1 to the Su1 element.
